# Eduro Learning

> > Eduro Learning delivers instructional coaching, professional development, and leadership programs for educators and international schools worldwide.

Eduro Learning specializes in coaching-based professional development for educators, with a focus on the Thrive Model and certificate programs like COETAIL. The organization serves international school communities across multiple countries and offers both cohort-based and self-paced learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- Thrive Model
- Instructional Coaching
- Professional Development
- COETAIL (Certificate of Educational Technology & Information Literacy)
- Women Who Lead
- International Schools
- Educational Technology
- School Leadership
- Coaching Culture
- Educator Mentoring
- Leadership Development
- Cohort-Based Learning
- ISTE Standards
- Kim Cofino
- coachbetter.tv
